info.name: Get events matching the interest stored on the node

params.name: sep
params.description: Name of the field in the Events header that holds the separator value e.g. 'model'

params.name: sepValue
params.description: The value of the field in the Events header indicated by the separator key e.g. multibase encoded model ID

params.name: streamId
params.description: the stream to filter (multibase encoded stream ID)

params.name: offset
params.description: token that designates the point to resume from, that is find keys added after this point

params.name: limit
params.description: the maximum number of events to return, default is 10000.
